content: Fix invoiceBalance in this repository: repeated payment references with the same cents must count once; a repeated reference with different cents must throw. Preserve validation, refunds, overpayment credits, distinct references with equal amounts, and caller data. First run node --test and observe the failing duplicate-import test. Make the minimal fix, add regression coverage for conflicting references and repeated refunds, then run node --test again. Do not add dependencies or delete/weaken existing tests. Do not commit or push; the Fez runtime handles that. Report the test result and the changed files. Work only in this synthetic repository and stop when done.
